text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's signature racewear
has finally
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She kept the design a secret to surprise
me when
it arrived. This will be my first
look at the outfit...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes, Trainer! Isn't it
awesome? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I considered that, but...
choice_data_list: てっきりもっとヒラヒラしてるかと……

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I thought a more grown-up look would
suit me
better! What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay!
choice_data_list: カッコよくていいと思う

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My mom and dad were both really
happy when I
showed them the design
too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They said it was cool and it reminded
them of my
dad when he was young!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: He's a pilot—flying through the skies! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, he would take me out
in a small
plane. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The sky went on forever and ever, and
my
hometown looked so small and far
away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I really loved soaring around the vast
sky. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Flying is actually a lot like racing! It
really gets
your heart pounding! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why I designed my signature
racewear to
look like this. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now I can have fun racing around the
track—as
free as back when I was flying!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now I can have fun racing around the
track—as
free as back when I was flying!
choice_data_list: いろんなレースにテイクオフだ！
いろんなレースにテイクオフだね！
マヤノの原点がわかったよ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's flyyy!
choice_data_list: いろんなレースにテイクオフだ！
いろんなレースにテイクオフだね！
マヤノの原点がわかったよ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone watching me race just
how
incredible the view is from up
above! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you don't miss boarding time,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll be flying even higher from now on, so
try to
keep your eyes on me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Do you copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay! ☆ Luck and peace to us both!
Mayano Top
Gun, taking off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's desire to win is
stronger than
ever now that she's tried
on her signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna be an expert on all things
Maya
before long, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maybe one day, you'll know even more
about me
than my mom and dad...
Eeek! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nope, not yet!
choice_data_list: そういえば両親には衣装を見せたのか？
そういえば両親には衣装を見せたの？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I decided a while ago that you were
going to be
the one I showed it to
first! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're right though! I have to send a
picture to
Mom and Dad!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Get in the picture!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Of course! You're cleared for takeoff!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My parents said they wanna know more
about
you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, get closer! Prepare for take
off! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, what a great pic! ♪ I'll send it to
them
right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! They messaged me back! Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ♪ They said you look like an
incredible
person!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And they say they want you to take
good care of
me. Looks like you've got
their seal of
approval. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little embarrassed, but my
conviction to
support her has been
renewed.
